full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
Notice-4
2083 Baisakh 3, Thursday
Information regarding changes in committee members
In accordance with the Federal Parliament Joint Meeting and Joint Committee (Operation) Regulations, 2080 and the House of Representatives Regulations, 2079, the Hon'ble Speaker, using the authority vested under Rule 260 and 265 of the House of Representatives Regulations, 2071, has made changes to the list of Hon'ble Members in the committees formed, to be proposed for agreement after the commencement of the session. This notice is published for the information of the Hon'ble Members of the Federal Parliament regarding the changes in committee members as follows.

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: This section announces changes to the membership of various parliamentary committees. The Hon'ble Speaker has made these changes under the authority of the House of Representatives Regulations.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: A detailed list of committee member reassignments is provided, specifying the member, the committee they are moving from, and the committee they are moving to. This includes changes to the Parliamentary Hearing Committee, State Affairs and Good Governance Committee, International Relations and Tourism Committee, Education, Health and Information Technology Committee, and Industry, Commerce and Labour and Consumer Interest Committee.
key_issues: State Affairs and Good Governance Committee
Education, Health and Information Technology Committee
Industry, Commerce and Labour and Consumer Interest Committee

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The notice concludes with the designation of Harka Raj Rai as Secretary of the House of Representatives.
